verses.english: Five Discourses on Accomplishment in Ethics, Etc. (1st)

verses.pali: “Sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṁ pubbaṅgamaṁ etaṁ pubbanimittaṁ, yadidaṁ—aruṇuggaṁ;
verses.english: “Mendicants, the dawn is the forerunner and harbinger of the sunrise.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etaṁ pubbaṅgamaṁ etaṁ pubbanimittaṁ, yadidaṁ—sīlasampadā.
verses.english: In the same way accomplishment in ethics is the forerunner and harbinger of the arising of the noble eightfold path for a mendicant.
A mendicant accomplished in ethics can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path. …” …
